title: Nest UI Design Spec
status: Interactive UI design v0.5; application foundation exists, workflow integrations pending
purpose: Adapt supplied UI references into Nest-styled screen designs and consolidate implementation requirements for the real backend.

identity.selected: Original woven Nest with a solid circular egg
identity.selection_note: The initial identity is selected. Circular Stellar-inspired variations remain exploratory.

foundations.style: Raven-derived forest surfaces, cream text, orange actions, IBM Plex Serif titles, Sans controls and Mono financial data.
foundations.layout: Workspace-first. Brand cover is collateral rather than a large in-app hero.

reference_handling.source: UI samples supplied by the user
reference_handling.interpretation: Capture layout and interaction intent, then adapt to Nest's visual system and authoritative product behavior.
deliverables_per_screen: Loading, empty, partial, stale, validation, error and confirmed states as applicable
Data fields, units, freshness and real backend bindings
Acceptance criteria, decisions and unresolved questions
reference_handling.backend_rule: Resolve bindings from the actual backend contract. Mark unknown fields or capabilities explicitly; do not invent endpoints or imply unsupported execution.
reference_handling.mock_data_rule: Keep illustrative values labeled and separate from verified live data.
reference_handling.aggregation: Maintain one consolidated screen specification and a shared component catalogue as references arrive.

Explicit snapshot/source coverage and execution separation

references.observed: Two-column IRIS intent builder. Left rail selects Collateral, Debt, Maturity, Max Rate and Venue; the right panel edits the current choice. Debt shows asset, amount and LTV slider. Maximum-rate view shows an exact input plus Tight/Mid/Wide choices.
keep: Full context remains visible while a field is edited
adapt: Nest forest/cream/orange and IBM Plex families
Horizon replaces universal Maturity; actual term/maturity is market-capability dependent
Blend, Templar and XOXNO compared at identical inputs
Presets are illustrative until generated from verified current quotes

references.observed: Position management includes venue-sourced health, adding collateral, withdrawing permitted excess collateral and repayment/close-out. IRIS describes venue-specific liquidation boundaries and separate fixed-term/solver behavior.
keep: Withdraw excess collateral only when valid
Repay and close with explicit cost and collateral-release preview
do_not_generalize: A universal health-factor threshold for incompatible venue metrics
Full-term fixed interest for all Nest loans
IRIS maturity and grace rules on markets that do not expose them

references.observed: IRIS documents Active, Grace period and Liquidatable phases; quote-bound overdue rates/grace periods and fixed-term early-close interest. These inform a conditional term-loan panel, not generic assumptions about Nest venues.
Knowledge graph beside a note reader; searchable Markdown-note list; linked notes and context summary; separate execution-policy editor lower on the page.
references.adapt: Nest keeps the graph, reader, note search and linked navigation. Accepted preferences and proposals remain distinct; policy editing moves to the existing Guardrails authority. Do not inherit Pilot's automatic-execution or mandatory caps.

references.inspection: Resolved through the live Backtests navigation because the supplied backtest URL duplicated Memory and included a trailing comma.
references.observed: Bounded configuration, sample/historical modes, post-cost equity and benchmark, drawdown/cost/fill metrics, event audit, saved-run comparison and frozen reproducibility evidence.
references.adapt: Nest uses a compact configuration rail and dominant evidence/results area. Preview calculations use explicitly synthetic XLM/USDC observations. Real historical replay remains a separately implemented service.

references.inspection: Browser inspected after asynchronous content loaded
references.observed: Strategy presets, editable bounds, review-first simulated lifecycle, per-event checks, portfolio effect and event timeline.
references.adapt: Nest's P0 builder starts from arbitrary supported conditions, not a fixed strategy menu. Use Source→Condition→Action, one test, explicit revision review and activation. P0 actions notify or propose an action; no unattended signing.

screens.title: Guardrails settings drawer
screens.status: Target interface contract; see the application README for implemented capabilities.

entry.label: Guardrails
entry.location: Top right of the global header, immediately beside Connect Wallet or the connected WalletMenu
entry.availability: Available across every workspace route, including before wallet connection
entry.mobile: Keep a compact labeled Guardrails control beside the wallet control in the header; open the same settings as a full-width mobile drawer.

layout.surface: Right-side settings drawer using the existing Nest tokens, with a full-height sheet on narrow screens
layout.footer: Persistent Save and Cancel controls, changed-settings summary, and saved policy revision
layout.proposal_notice: Numerical defaults are proposals to confirm. Display proposed values explicitly; never silently treat a suggestion as a saved preference.

scope.guest: May inspect settings and edit a transient draft; persistent Save requires wallet connection and ownership verification
scope.wallet_or_network_change: Load the new scope explicitly; never copy an unsaved draft or saved policy to another scope without user action

controls.label: Maximum slippage
controls.behavior: An explicitly accepted value is an execution bound, enforced by the application and the supported transaction path

controls.label: Price impact warning
controls.behavior: Warn above the accepted threshold; a warning alone does not block or exclude a route
controls.optional_hard_limit: A separate hard price-impact ceiling may be explicitly enabled by the user; it is disabled by default

controls.label: Maximum quote age
controls.behavior: Effective expiry is the earliest accepted maximum age, provider expiry, transaction validity, or tighter applicable chain/venue validity bound; show the actual countdown

controls.label: Fees
controls.input: Optional custom ceiling in explicit fee asset and units
controls.behavior: Always show and obtain approval for the prepared action's maximum venue, aggregator and network fees. An optional custom ceiling can impose a stricter bound. A material fee-maximum change requires renewed review.

controls.label: Lending health
controls.input: Separate configurable minimum and warning threshold in the venue's native risk metric

proposed_warning.metric: Health factor, only where supported and semantically applicable

controls.behavior: Do not apply 1.5 across incompatible venue metrics. Show warnings separately from a user-configured blocking minimum. Chain/venue collateral and liquidation validity requirements always apply.

controls.label: Data freshness
controls.input: Per-source maximum age/tolerance with units and source identity
controls.behavior: Enforce accepted source tolerances during quote and preview generation, using observation/provider as-of time rather than retrieval time alone. Stricter chain, oracle or venue validity cannot be relaxed by this setting.

optional_caps.behavior: No mandatory global caps. The approved intent defines the action amount. Apply additional caps only after the user explicitly enables and saves them.
optional_caps.retained_checks: Account balances, chain reserves, market liquidity/capacity, contract validity, approved payload bounds and venue rules remain mandatory

interaction.open: Fetch the active saved revision and initialize a separate editable draft; clearly identify any unconfirmed suggestions
interaction.edit: Changes remain local to the drawer draft until Save; no autosave or agent write path
interaction.save: Validate on the server under authenticated wallet/network ownership and an expected revision; explicit Save creates a new auditable policy revision
interaction.conflict: Preserve the draft, display the newer saved revision and require explicit review/reapplication; never silently overwrite either revision
interaction.success: Display the saved revision and confirmation, invalidate affected prepared plans and refresh their review state
interaction.cancel: Discard the draft and leave the active saved policy unchanged
interaction.unsaved_close: Require an explicit discard decision before losing edits
interaction.agent_boundary: The agent may explain or propose changes but cannot save, accept or silently modify guardrails
interaction.validity_boundary: User preferences cannot override chain or venue validity requirements

Support Escape with unsaved-edit handling, visible focus, screen-reader validation/status announcements and 44px touch targets
Warnings include text/icons and do not rely on color

acceptance: Guardrails is beside Connect Wallet/WalletMenu on desktop and remains discoverable on mobile

screens.purpose: Capture a complete borrowing intent and compare integrated venues at the same collateral, debt, horizon and constraints.

interaction: Selecting a term focuses the corresponding right editor without dropping the other selected terms.
A field-specific Apply validates its draft and updates the intent. Invalid text remains visible with an inline error and cannot poison the last valid comparison.
Changing any applied input invalidates the old executable quote set. A real implementation immediately disables stale Review actions while recomputing.
Compare venues requests a bounded concurrent quote set for the exact inputs. Timeouts and exclusions remain visible.
Picking a venue result creates a typed proposal; it does not sign or submit.
Supply opportunities navigate to the direct-supply/vault discovery view rather than changing a borrow into a supply silently.
Reset clears only the local form/comparison draft; it does not alter saved policy or positions.

screens.title: Borrow

screens.purpose: Monitor lending positions and execute supported collateral, repayment and exit actions with venue-native validity and clear settlement state.

layout.summary: Four metrics: confirmed collateral, outstanding debt, net credit value and separately tracked pending workflows, with valuation time.
layout.desktop: Flexible left content for open positions, selected-position health and details; 340px sticky action ticket right.
layout.position_table: Venue/market/account identity, collateral, debt, native risk, Manage action. Keep account IDs separate from wallet and market IDs.
layout.health_panel: Selected venue-native metric, liquidation boundary, valuation/debt/rate facts, actual maturity where supported, source/as-of time. Never present configured warnings as chain validity boundaries.
layout.ticket: Add collateral, withdraw collateral, repay, repay & close. Amount, before/after deltas, resulting native risk, withdrawal timing for additions, eligibility reason and shared-review action.
layout.below: Pending external workflow timeline, conditional term/close-out details and activity/receipt history.
layout.responsive: Below 1100px in the specimen (1024px production baseline), ticket stacks under context; below 768px metrics become 2 columns and timelines wrap in order.

management_actions.rules: Check ownership, asset/network identity, balance/reserves, market capability and post-action health. Show that collateral release remains conditional on debt, health and liquidity.

Disable when liquidatable or a venue/grace restriction applies, or when the projected action breaches chain/venue validity. Available amount comes from the adapter; a generic Max cannot introduce an unsupported withdraw-all sentinel.
Support partial repayment only where the market supports it. Adapter determines exact rounding and close-out behavior.

management_actions.intent_kind: repay followed by supported collateral release steps
management_actions.rules: A generic positive repayment must not silently become repay-all. Full close and collateral release may require multiple separately reviewed steps. Do not assume early repayment reduces term interest, nor assume full-term interest without market evidence.

capability_conditional_facts.Blend: Use pool-native accounting and risk/receipt conversions. No backstop or recursive leverage in P0.
capability_conditional_facts.XOXNO: Bind wallet, NFT-backed lending account, spoke, hub and market IDs separately. Reverify current account ownership before prepare and submit. No P0 migration, NFT transfer, flash loan or looping.
capability_conditional_facts.Templar: Preserve Stellar-origin funding, protocol authorization, external settlement and debt delivery as distinct receipts. Funding confirmation does not mean borrowing completed. Queued supply withdrawals have actual request/queue/execution/cancellation states.
capability_conditional_facts.term_market: Only when returned by the adapter: fixed/floating type, maturity, overdue rate, grace end, liquidation phase, full-term interest/early-close rule and settlement/repayment state. IRIS reference values do not supply Nest terms.

states.healthy: Show native metric and actual venue boundary; provide supported actions
states.warning: Show an accepted policy warning independently of any blocking minimum; require fresh preview
states.liquidatable: Withdrawal disabled with reason; surface supported add-collateral and repay/exit paths
states.matured_or_grace: Only for supported terms; show exact deadlines/costs and permitted actions
states.pending_signature: Keep reviewed exact changes visible; stale/mutated response rejected
states.submitted_reconciling: Show receipt/hash and progress without claiming success
states.partial_completion: Retain completed effects and remaining exposure; new review for a permitted recovery action
states.confirmed: Display actual token/debt/collateral effects and refresh positions
states.no_positions: Explain wallet/ownership requirements and link Borrow/Supply without fabricated balances
states.stale_position: Show last observation and disable execution until refreshed

acceptance: Confirmed collateral, liabilities and net value use one valuation time and do not count receipts plus backing twice.
Pending funding/workflows are tracked separately from confirmed borrowed assets and collateral totals.
Every position exposes supported exit actions and explicit unavailable reasons.
Liquidatable and unsafe post-action withdrawals cannot reach signing.
Collateral additions show withdrawal duration/restrictions before approval.
Repay and close display actual venue costs rather than assuming IRIS mechanics.
A Templar funding receipt cannot mark borrowing complete.
XOXNO ownership, native amount semantics and protocol IDs are revalidated.
Every action uses the same prepared-plan review, expiry/policy binding and confirmed receipt reconciliation.
